name: uimator
description: 把运行中的 H5 / Electron 界面拆成 3D 舞台素材，用模板化的镜头、灯光与排版，导出一条产品宣发短片。

scripts.start:sandbox: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs
scripts.selftest: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --selftest
scripts.uicheck: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --uicheck
scripts.batch: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --batch
scripts.matrix: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --matrix
scripts.recap: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --recap
scripts.tree: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --tree
scripts.stage: npm run build && UIMATOR_SANDBOX=0 node scripts/run.mjs --stage
